verdict.rationale: Casium is an immigration law firm with a technology platform and client portal, so a documented public API is a fair question for it. The evidence describes only the web portal, attorney messaging and visa guides. Probes for OpenAPI/Swagger specs and llms.txt all returned 404, and no public API is documented anywhere in the pack.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
